pr_title: Improve tests and fix bugs in container validation
pr_body:

#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This fixes a bug in container validation caused by reusing the previously existing container validation methods that results in validation adding an extra index in the path of errors (e.g. `pod.spec.ephemeralcontainers[0][0].image` instead of `pod.spec.ephemeralcontainers[0].image`).

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #111028

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

I arranged the commits to try to make this PR easier to review.

1. The first commit changes the format (but not the content) of unit tests in order to make it easier to see what's changing in later commits.
2. The second commit expands unit test coverage based on gaps in `KUBE_COVER` and fixes tests that had multiple validation errors that would potentially mask the error under test.
3. The third commit refactors validation and fixes the bugs described in the unit tests.

I checked that unit tests are successful at each commit, and each commit has a description that describes the changes in more detail. Unfortunately I couldn't find a way to make github show better diffs for the line moves in commit 3 that introduced whitespace changes.

issue_context.title: Ephemeral Container validation prints incorrect path to ephemeral container
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

`validateEphemeralContainers` will add a superfuous index to validation errors for ephemeral containers due to the way container validation code is reused.

### Why is this needed?

Resolving this cosmetic issue is required for [Ephemeral Containers GA Graduation](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/277-ephemeral-containers#beta---ga-graduation)

review_comments: Should we fix the fact that this is run for templates?  It might require more plumbing, in a different PR?
What if Name == "" ?  Is that allowed?  This implies it is...

it's not allowed for any container type and will be checked in `validateContainer()` below. To make this behavior more clear I made `validateContainer()` the first check, added a comment, and added a test case.
